New paper out in #Transportation #Research Part F: #Traffic #Psychology and #Behaviour:

Understanding why we #move how we move: #Development and #validation of the #mobility #motivation #Survey (#MMS)

#OpenAccess

@cbehav.bsky.social@bsky.brid.gy

"Analyses of motive importance revealed a largely stable hierarchy across demographic groups and habitual mode use: Convenience & Autonomy, Time & Effort Efficiency, and Information & Orientation were consistently rated as the most important motives, whereas Sustainability & Health, Social Accessibility & Inclusion, and Productivity & Time Use were less salient for all subgroups, with the overall motive effects far outweighing the significant but small group differences."
